mapper.select: select mn.*,com.C_NAME as approvalCompanyName,us.U_NAME as approvalUserName,lead.U_NAME as approvalLeaderName from Pre_Project_Approval mn left join SYS_Company com on mn.approval_company_id = com.C_ID left join SYS_User us on mn.approval_user_id = us.U_ID left join SYS_User lead on mn.approval_leader= us.U_ID where mn.id = #{id}
